summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on the progress of its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced 30 April 2026. During the week ended 29 May 2026, 1,350,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €26.81 for a total of €36.2 million. Cumulatively, 7,500,000 shares have been repurchased at an average price of €25.58, representing ~19.19% of the programme's total value. The buyback is intended to reduce share capital. As a foreign private issuer, ING uses Form 6-K to report ongoing capital return execution. Watch for weekly updates and potential acceleration or completion of the programme.
